name: qarinah
description: Qarinah is worktree-aware project memory for coding agents - isolated per checkout and linked through a cited repository graph.

interface.longDescription: Qarinah gives every initialized Git worktree its own evidence-linked memory, automatically compacts completed coding turns into cited checkpoints, and groups sibling checkouts into one repository context graph. It captures explicitly permitted Codex lifecycle metadata into a local tamper-evident record, while read-only MCP tools report status, integrity, and compact task context.
defaultPrompt: Build a cited context pack for this task.
Show the decisions related to this change.
